title: DIY Fall Barn Quilts
seo_title: DIY Fall Barn Quilts Workshop in Ozark, MO
description: This is a hands-on painting workshop where you paint a barn quilt, a folk art piece based on traditional quilt block patterns, on a 12-inch by 12-inch metal board. You choose from four designs, and the pre-drawn pattern, paint, and all supplies are provided so you can take home a piece ready to display. It takes place Wednesday, November 11, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at The Workshop, 840 Finley Farms Ln, Ozark, MO.
